name: Shimri
overview: Shimri was a male Levite known primarily as the son of Hosah. He held the distinctive position of being made the firstborn, a role that carried significance within his family and tribe. There are no additional notes or details about his life beyond this designation.
namesAndTitles: The name Shimri means 'YHWH guards, preserves,' reflecting a meaningful theophoric element that acknowledges God's protective nature. This name is a proper name recorded in 1 Chronicles 26:10 and was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Shimri is explicitly identified as the son of Hosah. Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Shimri's importance in the biblical narrative centers on his role as the firstborn son of Hosah within the tribe of Levi. This status likely carried responsibilities and privileges in the Levitical order, contributing to the organization and service of the Levites. His mention in 1 Chronicles 26:10 situates him within the genealogical and priestly records that affirm God's established order among His people.
